description: This is a Python source file implementing a configuration class for interacting with Google Cloud Vertex AI's RAG API. It provides methods to generate authenticated requests, transform requests and responses, and manage vector store configurations specifically tailored to Vertex AI's vector store and corpus operations.

classes.name: VertexVectorStoreConfig
classes.description: A class extending BaseVectorStoreConfig and VertexBase that provides configuration and transformation methods for interacting with Vertex AI's RAG API, including request/response transformations, environment validation, and URL formation.

methods.name: BaseVectorStoreAuthCredentials get_auth_credentials( self, litellm_params: dict )
methods.description: Obtains authentication headers for Vertex AI API using credentials and project info derived from litellm_params.

methods.name: VectorStoreIndexEndpoints get_vector_store_endpoints_by_type(self)
methods.description: Returns the API endpoints for read and write operations for the vector store.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, litellm_params: Optional[GenericLiteLLMParams] )
methods.description: Sets up authentication environment by updating headers with credentials for the Vertex AI RAG API.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs the base URL for Vertex AI RAG API calls based on location and project.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict[str,Any]] transform_search_vector_store_request( self, vector_store_id: str, query: Union[str, List[str]], vector_store_search_optional_params: VectorStoreSearchOptionalRequestParams, api_base: str, litellm_logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms the search query into a Vertex AI RAG API request format, including URL, request body, and optional parameters.

methods.name: VectorStoreSearchResponse transform_search_vector_store_response( self, response: httpx.Response, litellm_logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj )
methods.description: Processes the Vertex AI RAG API search response, extracting contexts and formatting them into a standard search results response.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict[str,Any]] transform_create_vector_store_request( self, vector_store_create_optional_params: VectorStoreCreateOptionalRequestParams, api_base: str, )
methods.description: Prepares a request body for creating a new Vertex AI RAG corpus.

methods.name: VectorStoreCreateResponse transform_create_vector_store_response( self, response: httpx.Response )
methods.description: Transforms the creation response from Vertex AI into a standardized vector store response object.
